correctness.rationale: Complete additivity and induction give \(S(t)\le t\). For composite \(m=ab\), the equality \(S(m)=m-1\) forces \((a-1)(b-1)\le2\), leaving only \(m=4,6\), of which only \(6\) works. The Ruth–Aaron prime-member conclusion then follows exactly.
